pli-tv-bi-vb-pc91:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc91:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo sikkhamānāya ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipi …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.2: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihiniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.5: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihiniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gihiniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.10: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gihiniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc93:1.13.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gihiniyā ummaddāpeyya vā parimaddāpeyya vā pācittiyanti.
